name: Museo de Antioquia
funding: Ministerio de las Culturas, Alcaldía de Medellín, Área Metropolitana; aliados include EPM, Bancolombia, SURA, Mineros, Metro de Medellín, Comfama and the Chamber of Commerce.

name: Museo de Arte Moderno de Medellín (MAMM)
funding: Mid-size private museum founded 1978; pillars are Medellín city hall, national Culture Ministry, Comfama, SURA, Bancolombia, EPM, Fundación Fraternidad and Fundación MUV.

name: Museo de Arte Costarricense (MAC)
funding: Ministry of Culture museum with a 2021 budget of about COLONES 1.77bn (about US$3M), 48% of it salaries.

name: Museo de Arte y Diseño Contemporáneo
funding: Agency of Costa Rica's Ministry of Culture, paid through the national budget. Budget pages are online for 2013 to 2020.

name: TEOR/éTica
funding: Private non-profit founded 1999 by Virginia Pérez-Ratton; funders not disclosed.

name: MSU Zagreb (Museum of Contemporary Art)
funding: City of Zagreb; listed sponsors include public companies ZET and HRT.

name: WHW (What, How & for Whom) / Galerija Nova
funding: Its supporters page names Zaklada Kultura Nova, the Ministarstvo kulture i medija Republike Hrvatske and the Foundation for Arts Initiatives.

name: Fábrica de Arte Cubano
funding: Founded by musician X Alfonso. In 2014 the Cuban Music Institute and Ministry of Culture were covering some costs until it became self-financing.

name: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes de La Habana
funding: State museum subordinate to Cuba's Ministry of Culture.

name: Nicosia Municipal Arts Centre (NiMAC)
funding: Nicosia Municipality and the Pierides Foundation run it under a cooperation agreement. Shows credit the Deputy Ministry of Culture, A.G. Leventis Foundation and European University Cyprus. No budget is published.

name: MeetFactory
funding: The City of Prague gives MeetFactory a grant of 12.000.000 CZK in 2026.
